description.value: Laughing Falls is a natural waterfall situated within Yoho National Park on the western slopes of the Great Divide in British Columbia, part of the Canadian Rocky Mountain Parks UNESCO World Heritage Site. The park is celebrated for its glaciers, dramatic peaks, and cascading waterfalls, and lies along the Trans-Canada Highway corridor — a heavily travelled touring route for cyclists. Visiting the falls requires leaving the road and hiking a trail into the Yoho Valley.
